integrity: Two exact enumeration engines independently regenerate all admissible words through length 46. One uses suffix-only incremental pruning; the other directly rescans each candidate for all square factors and all 3834 allowed restricted morphisms. They agree on every level and on the 18 extremizers.
scientific_limitations: The exact cutoff 45 is for the restricted square-free certificate language with |h(A)|=1 and |h(B)|+|h(C)|<=5. It is not claimed to be the maximum length of an unrestricted ternary ABCA.ACBA-avoider. Unpublished source-author backtracking output could contain the same cutoff or boundary list.
title: Sharp length-\(45\) obstruction for the palindromic formula \(\mathtt{ABCA.ACBA}\)
